items.title: How Wall Street tech and South Korean stock market are becoming increasingly intertwined
items.description: The 60-day correlation between the Kospi and Nasdaq 100 recently climbed to about 0.50, its highest level since 2021, according to data provided by Rayliant.

items.title: Shares of SK Hynix plunge 10% in Seoul as semiconductor selloff deepens
items.description: South Korean semiconductor shares tumbled on Tuesday, extending a rout in chipmakers after another weak session on Wall Street.

items.title: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei says AI company isn't advocating for ban of open-weight models
items.description: Critics have questioned why Anthropic didn't sign an industry letter last week in support of open-weight models.

items.title: CNBC's The China Connection newsletter: A U.S.-China debate that's becoming bigger than tariffs
items.description: The AI race is heating up so fast this summer that it's reshaping national priorities in the U.S. and China.

items.title: Trump administration asks Supreme Court to intervene to allow mail-in voting restrictions
items.description: A federal appeals court on Saturday kept the restrictions blocked in 23 states that sued, finding states must prepare for potentially disruptive election changes.

items.title: Jim Cramer warns AI's circular financing frenzy echoes the dot-com bubble
items.description: CNBC's Jim Cramer said reports of Nvidia backing OpenAI's data center expansion revived memories of the financing arrangements that preceded the dot-com crash.

items.title: Sam Altman to meet with Trump administration, senators this week. Here's what he plans to say
items.description: Altman will preview the capabilities of the company's upcoming family of AI models and answer questions about cybersecurity and open-weight models.

items.title: Nvidia and OpenAI in talks for up to $250 billion backstop to fund AI infrastructure plans
items.description: The backstop would let OpenAI raise debt for a data center campus in Pike County, Ohio, on the strength of Nvidia's credit.

items.title: SpaceX has now lost the equivalent of a full Tesla in market capitalization
items.description: Elon Musk's space company has wiped off more than $1.2 trillion in market cap since hitting a high of $225.64 per share in June.

items.title: Apple ends day as world's most valuable company, passing Nvidia
items.description: Nvidia had held the top spot as the most valuable company since June 2025, when it took the crown from Microsoft.

items.title: From 'oil' to 'shock',  here's what Kalshi traders expect Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh will say this week
items.description: Kalshi traders are predicting Warsh will mention last week's supply shock at this week's Federal Reserve press conference.

items.title: Oil prices slide, Brent crude below $90 as pause to U.S.-Iran hostilities appears to hold
items.description: Oil prices fell after Iran reportedly said it would suspend attacks as long as a U.S. pause in hostilities remains in place.

items.title: Trump says U.S. has sold more than $13 billion of Venezuela oil since Maduro's capture
items.description: President Donald Trump said Monday the U.S. has sold more than $13 billion of Venezuelan oil since taking control of the South American nation's energy exports.

items.title: NBCUniversal and YouTube ink deal to embed Peacock in the video platform for premium subscribers
items.description: Beginning in early 2027, YouTube Premium subscribers will receive the entirety of Peacock content, including sports and movies.

items.title: Consolidated food supply may be worsening cyclospora outbreaks, experts say
items.description: Experts say food industry consolidation may be amplifying the cyclospora outbreak, allowing contaminated produce to spread farther.

items.title: Nvidia's potential $250B backstop for OpenAI is another strike against the AI trade
items.description: This is yet another sign that investors need to look beyond AI stocks.

items.title: Op-ed: Over 2,000 proposals aim to govern AI. Not a single one addresses a long-term regulatory framework
items.description: AI can't be regulated by the invisible hand of the market. We need a comprehensive future-focused regulatory framework.

items.title: Crypto stocks rally thanks to rotation from AI infrastructure; bitcoin miners lag
items.description: Crypto stocks proved some of the top gainers Monday even as the broader market sold off and  capital rotated away from chip and AI infrastructure names.

items.title: Netanyahu, Zelenskyy come to DC for Graham's funeral, meetings with Trump amid wars
items.description: The funeral for Sen. Lindsey Graham is bringing world leaders to Washington at a time when many are eager to meet with President Donald Trump amid wars.

items.title: Trump backs 'fantastic' Warsh while calling for lower rates and citing 'bad intentions' of other Fed officials
items.description: President Trump Monday voiced support for Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh while insisting that the U.S. should have the lowest interest rates in the world.
